factual_claims.claim: These gains were partly offset by lower revenue from other LNG terminal activities and the reduction of LNG security supplement income following the repayment of excess returns from regulated activities in 2022–2023.

Note 13(3) states the security supplement income decreased due to 'proportionally recognised repayment of the excess returns (surplus income) from regulated activities during the period 2022-2023.'

details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K3, K4, K5, and K6 are all PRESENT with supporting sentences identified. K7 is MISSING as there is no mention of the establishment of KN Energies Deutschland GmbH in September 2024 to operate the Wilhelmshaven 2 floating LNG import terminal. The summary captures most material information (group revenue, net profit, operating profit drivers, segment performance, cash flow, balance sheet changes, and FSRU acquisition impact), but the omission of the KN Energies Deutschland GmbH establishment means not all HIGH-priority items are fully covered, resulting in a 'Generally yes' score.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements logically follow one another without contradictions. The financial narrative progresses from revenue growth through cost impacts to profitability metrics and cash flow results. While some figures are offsetting (e.g., gains partially offset by lower revenue in S6), these are presented as balanced financial realities rather than contradictions. The structure follows a logical sequence from top-line performance through to cash position and equity, with clear causal relationships (e.g., S4 explains S3, S8 explains S7). There is no unnecessary repetition, and all components work together to form a unified financial story.
